angle_rule: JLC rotation = (KiCad rotation + correction) modulo 360; Top only

C882406.basis: Supplied JLCPCB preview: upper-left package marking agrees with PCB pin 1.

C365743.basis: Supplied JLCPCB preview has the package marking at lower-left; rotate clockwise 90 degrees to PCB upper-left pin 1.

C51118.basis: Supplied JLCPCB preview has two leads above / three below. Rotate clockwise 90 degrees to PCB three leads left / two right, pin 1 upper-left.

C51315120.basis: SOT-323 top-view zero uses pin 1 lower-left, pin 2 lower-right and pin 3 above. KiCad zero has pins 1/2 left. KiCad 90 plus 270 gives CPL 0: pins 1/2 below, pin 3 above. New JLCPCB preview must confirm this part-specific convention.
